name: How do you vet international buyers for luxury properties?

mainEntity.name: How do you vet international buyers for luxury properties?

acceptedAnswer.text: Vetting international buyers for luxury properties involves a comprehensive qualification process. This includes verifying financial capability, often through proof of funds or pre-approval from reputable financial institutions. We also conduct due diligence to understand their investment goals and ensure alignment with the property's offerings. A first-party insight is our established network with international financial advisors and legal experts who assist in verifying buyer credibility and ensuring transaction compliance.
acceptedAnswer.description: We vet international buyers by verifying financial capability and investment goals, often utilizing our network of international financial and legal experts for due diligence.
